questions.stem: A 24-year-old man in the ICU is suffering from acute respiratory distress syndrome. Which one of the following statements is true for the dead space volume as seen in this patient?
questions.stemHtml: A 24-year-old man in the ICU is suffering from acute respiratory distress syndrome. Which one of the following statements is true for the dead space volume as seen in this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Physiologic dead space = Anatomical dead space

options.label: B
options.text: Physiologic dead space > Anatomical dead space

options.label: C
options.text: Physiologic dead space < Anatomical dead space

options.label: D
options.text: Physiologic dead space < Alveolar dead space
